major_cooldowns.name: Ray of Frost
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it early in the opener, keep it off two charges, and cancel the channel after a GCD once two or more enemies are up.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 205021 is the cast id, 67 casts in 5/5 parses. Hand of Frost grants a second charge, so expected casts run above one per 60s.

major_cooldowns.name: Frozen Orb
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it on cooldown and place it so the orb rolls through the whole pack, then follow it with Blizzard while Freezing Rain is up.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 84714 is the cast id (85 casts in 5/5 parses); the same-name 84721 was never observed.

major_cooldowns.name: Flurry
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fire it the moment Brain Freeze lands, once you have spent a Thermal Void that is still running.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 44614 is the cast id (291 casts in 5/5 parses); the same-name 228354 was never observed. Brain Freeze resets the cooldown, so casts far exceed one per 30s.

major_cooldowns.name: Comet Storm
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: It replaces Ray of Frost once you channel it, so fire it a couple of GCDs after Glacial Spike to let Rapid Refreezing finish.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Guide links spell=1247777, the only Comet Storm row in the table; it is marked NOT observed and its tooltip reads as the talent node, and no Comet Storm cast id appears in the sampled parses. Cooldown mirrors Ray of Frost, which it replaces after a cast.

major_cooldowns.name: Time Warp
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it just before Ray of Frost, or at the moment your group calls for it.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 80353 cast in 3/5 parses; raids rotate the haste buff between casters.

major_cooldowns.name: Freightrunner's Flask
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it right after Frozen Orb or Glacial Spike, with a Ray of Frost charge banked and your Freezing stacks low.
major_cooldowns.id_note: On-use item the APL names as freightrunners_flask and gates on the ff/ss trinket timing variable; cast in 2/5 parses.

rule.description: Open Frostbolt into Flurry, Frozen Orb, Ray of Frost
rule.action: Pre-cast Frostbolt, chain Flurry into Frozen Orb, then get Ray of Frost rolling.

rule.description: Ice Lance over Frostbolt on Fingers of Frost
rule.action: Throw Ice Lance instead of Frostbolt while Fingers of Frost is up, and never leave it sitting at its 2 stack cap.
Fire Flurry as soon as Brain Freeze lands, and only hold it long enough to use up a running Thermal Void.

rule.description: Blizzard joins the rotation on multiple targets
rule.action: Weave Blizzard in when enemies stack up, and hold it to follow Frozen Orb so Freezing Rain covers it.

rule.description: Ray of Frost while Icicles are low
rule.action: Channel Ray of Frost while your Icicles are low so it neither overcaps them nor delays Glacial Spike.

rule.description: Time Warp into Ray of Frost
rule.action: Pop Time Warp just before you send Ray of Frost so the haste covers the channel.
